channels.name: Transmit serial lane (TX)
channels.purpose: FC-0 transmit lane carrying encoded frames + ordered sets.
channels.active_levels: differential / optical NRZ (PAM-4 at 64GFC) at the negotiated GFC rate

channels.name: Receive serial lane (RX)
channels.purpose: FC-0 receive lane recovering encoded frames + ordered sets (embedded-clock CDR).

channels.name: Power / ground (analog + digital)
channels.purpose: SerDes analog rails and digital core supply.

dependency_graph.common_rule: VALID once asserted MUST remain asserted until READY also asserted on the same cycle
dependency_graph.AXI_read: ARVALID precedes RVALID; RVALID stays asserted until ARREADY accepted and final RLAST transferred

logical_signaling_levels.name: Active frame
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: SOF .. 24-byte header .. payload .. 32-bit CRC .. EOF on the serial lane.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Idle
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: IDLE ordered sets between frames (maintains synchronization).

logical_signaling_levels.name: Not operational
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: NOS/OLS primitive sequence when the link is down.
